sant_andrea_catabarbara_v1.note: Church installed c. 470 in the hall of the Basilica of Junius Bassus (cos. 331); placed on the basilica's Pleiades position so the two records chain on one site.

porta_praenestina_labicana.note: Drawn by the building record porta_maggiore (district B), which models the aqueduct arches and the Honorian gate.

circus_of_gaius_and_nero_v2.note: Coordinator: the derelict circus is ended when Constantine's builders levelled the Vatican slope for St Peter's (c. 320); the rotundas and the obelisk then stood on its former spina line.
